name: STERIS
description: STERIS sells infection-prevention and surgical products to hospitals, and sterilization services to medical-device and drug makers. The mix is service 48 percent (equipment maintenance, instrument and scope repair, contract sterilization, lab testing), consumables 30 percent (detergents, endoscopy accessories, barrier products) and capital equipment 21 percent (sterilizers, surgical tables). Applied Sterilization Technologies is a contract-sterilization service at a network of plants. It sold its Dental segment in fiscal 2025. Irish-domiciled, with most revenue in the US.
